After an unusually long three-week wait, Apple today released iOS 27 beta 5, and this update brings brand-new app icons for Siri, Safari, and more.

Apple rolls out app icon updates in iOS 27 beta 5

iOS 27 is getting closer to public release, expected next month.

Today's beta 5 brings several user-facing changes in preparation for the update's launch.

Among them, several system apps have gotten new icons:

  • Siri
  • Safari
  • Preview
  • Settings
  • Remote

You can see some of these new icons in the images above. Some other apps also appear to have very subtle updates.

Since the first beta, iOS 27 has introduced more icon design changes, with Apple continuing to refine last year's Liquid Glass style.

Apps like Maps, Photos, and Wallet have already been using new icons since iOS 27 began. But today's beta 5 revisions show that Apple's adjustments to iOS 27 icons are not yet finished.

What do you think of the latest app icon changes in iOS 27? Let us know in the comments.
